_why: v6. zlen = slices per pixel-width of material (a slice is thinner than a pixel); round = 3-D facet rounding in px. zlen fitted so the drift-registered band-pass (1-6 px) correlation between slices 1/2/4/8 apart matches the real stack, with in-plane x/y correlation unchanged. v5 had zlen 1, round 0: its structure changed ~1.6x too fast along the milling axis. approach = (strength, slices): surfaces just below the cut brighten into the face and the pore funnel fades out for them, fitted so slice-to-slice changes are as one-sided as real (big changes are darkenings): skew of the registered change real -2.05/-2.56/-1.28, v5 -0.77/-0.76/-0.21, v6 -1.90/-2.07/-1.00 (comp/uncomp/pristine).

comp.v7_note: e31: patch AUC 0.94 (v6 0.99; control 0.51); layer large-scale sd 21.7 (real 23.2), block sd 0.19 (0.20), layer p10/p50/p90 114/198/252 (111/194/253); support median 81 (75); zcorr/skew on real

uncomp.note: 1.15 fitted before approach; full stack at 1.15+approach gave zcorr 0.95/0.87/0.72/0.49, too persistent, so 1.0
uncomp.v7_note: u2: patch AUC 0.91 (v6 0.967; control 0.57); block sd 0.24 (real 0.24); ligament granulometry on real; pores slightly large

pristine.v7_note: p13: patch AUC 0.967 (v6 1.0, earlier v7 0.999; control 0.58); zcorr .87/.65/.42 (real .87/.67/.45) at zlen 1.08; edge ratio 1.16 (1.11); block sd 0.225 (0.248). Micropores dropped for pristine: they cost realism (AUC 0.999 vs 0.965) and were not the cause of the excess z-persistence (zlen was). Open: skew -0.8 vs real -1.21, unchanged by the approach length.

_v7: v7 overrides (applied by make_full.build unless --v6): each moved its own measured target on 40-slice comp test volumes (scorecard.py). ctx3d: support cavities as finite 3-D ellipsoids with exact ray-traced interiors and thin rims, no void-clamped pillars, no pixel-scale edge spikes, homogeneous cap. curtain_illum 8: stripe sd in cap and support (real ~8.3, v6 ~4). edge_dy: directional edge escape, top/bottom pore-edge ratio 1.24 (real 1.24; 1.6 compensates the micropores). noise_sig: scan-correlated noise (median-residual lag-1 corr x -0.01 real vs -0.11 white). grain x0.93. micropore: 1-3 px channel pores in the TRUTH, giving 2.1% dark specks inside solid-looking regions (real 2.3%) instead of painted texture. incl: sparse large dense particles with curtain stripes. sigma_y/x sharper. Only comp has been tested; uncomp/pristine pending.
_v7b: v7b additions: halo = edge blooming (electrons leaving a cut edge excite the pore wall just inside the rim; pore brightens from the rim inward), comp only: patch AUC 0.94 -> 0.82, costs some skew (-1.9 -> -1.3). sat_spread = detector saturates after the shot noise (saturated share spread above 255 before noise, then clipped): uncomp 0.91 -> 0.87. A beam-flare tail and a black-box tune of 12 existing knobs (tune.py) did not improve on these.
_v7c: v7c, from the temporal discriminator (temporal_scorecard.py): cubic_frame (cubic resampling; linear made sharpness pulse with the drift fraction), curtain_regional [cap weight, rate] (curtains under the layer and in the support, weak in the milled cap, slowly evolving; v7 painted one fixed stripe pattern over every frame), jitter [y, x] px (per-frame stage/beam position noise; real frame-to-frame residual ~0.3 px, v7 0.02), zlen_small/zlen_big (coarse structure persists along the milling axis longer than fine: real band-pass correlation coarse 8 apart 0.59, fine 4 apart 0.14). Test volumes, temporal AUC: comp 0.99->0.985 (reslice 0.84->0.66), uncomp 0.96->0.82, pristine 0.92->0.90. Cost: skew moves away from real (one-sidedness diluted by jitter and blooming). Jitter set to the measured frame position noise (frame-to-frame residual / sqrt 2): a first full stack at 0.35 px had 0.55 px frame-to-frame wobble against real 0.31 and drained the skew (comp -1.66 -> -0.82).
_v7d: v7d, from 'you can see things coming forward from the back in the real stack': pore pixels' correlation with the image k slices later (forward.py) real comp 0.98/.96/.90/.80/.74 at k=1/2/4/8/12, v7c 0.96/.91/.82/.71/.63. Halo, funnel, jitter and depth fall-off made no difference; pore size did (v5's big open pores matched it). Sparse 3-D macro-voids (macro_per_kpx 6, 25-55 px) give 0.98/.94/.88/.80/.75 at patch AUC 0.857. Uncomp's solid changed too fast (0.81/.60/.37 vs 0.88/.74/.51): zlen_small 0.85 -> 1.1.
